article.title: Claims, Routes, and What Survives: How Claimipedia and Sourcery Fit Together

exactForPinnedCapture: The 38-node four-generator relation representation has 66-dimensional unital associative closure.
The compressed Spin-Temple corner is M2(Q) and its commutator Lie algebra is sl2(Q).
The predecessor-closed 15-node carrier has Jacobson-radical quotient Q plus M2(Q).
The direct current-relationship route does not contain a second root channel sufficient for C2.
The quotient-scar mixed interface is the A8 zero-sum transfer lattice on its nine-node mixed core.
interpretive: Claimipedia supplies typed records and provenance; Sourcery checks declared compositions, assumptions and losses; operator linearization studies the resulting route structure.
The relation algebra is a model of the authored graph, not evidence of a physical symmetry.
A wall-response route closes as a bounded effective-model proposal, while a projector-memory route must refuse oriented quarter-turn promotion without an independent orientation datum.
